title: THE OLD ALBUM
author: Hardaman Singh
text:
The photos of old
in album scruffed

some torn and faded
still faithfully black cornered

fingers unsteady yet tracing the photos
emotions flicker on the wrinkled cheeks

there is a glint in the fading eyes
smile on the chapped lips

as memories flash and the head shakes
to the bygone days of capturing images

when the frames were so natural
the moods reflected so genuine

A deep breath and the moment passes
the gnarled hands affectionately

Move on the scruffed album...
